card.title: Rank Everything
card.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move my stress testing above troubleshooting. Your restart is third.

beats.text: For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move my stress testing above troubleshooting. Your restart is third.

mechanism: A repeatedly reclassifies printer work into a hierarchy that puts A above B even when A caused the blockage.
confusable: Unlike ordinary credit-seeking, A must rank each new contribution or fact rather than merely deny it.
comparison: D67-b promotes causing the problem into top-ranked testing; D67-a promotes commissioning over a newly revealed baker contribution.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
